preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= m <= 100000 and 1 <= k <= 100000 for m, k in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, m and k are between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a_i <= m for a_i, m in zip(flattened_a, test_m_values))
preconditions.description: Each a_i is between 0 and m for the corresponding test case.

preconditions.expression: all(sum(a) == m for a, m in zip(test_a_values, test_m_values))
preconditions.description: The sum of a_i for each test case equals m.

preconditions.expression: sum(test_m_values) + sum(len(a) for a in test_a_values) <= 200000
preconditions.description: The sum of m and k across all test cases does not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.description: The size of each matrix n is at least 1.

postconditions.expression: all(all(0 <= b_i_j <= k for b_i_j in row) for matrix in matrices for row in matrix)
postconditions.description: Each element b_{i, j} in the matrix is between 0 and k.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(sum(row) for row in matrix) == m for matrix, m in zip(matrices, test_m_values))
postconditions.description: The sum of all elements in each matrix equals m for the corresponding test case.

postconditions.expression: all(all(len(row) == n for row in matrix) for matrix, n in zip(matrices, matrix_sizes))
postconditions.description: Each matrix is square with size n.

postconditions.expression: all(all(len(set(diag)) == len(diag) for diag in [matrix[i][i] for i in range(n)] + [matrix[i][n-1-i] for i in range(n)]) for matrix, n in zip(matrices, matrix_sizes))
postconditions.description: The numbers on each diagonal of each 2x2 submatrix are distinct.

postconditions.expression: all(all(sum(matrix[i][j] for i in range(x, x+2) for j in range(y, y+2)) <= 3 for x in range(n-1) for y in range(n-1)) for matrix, n in zip(matrices, matrix_sizes))
postconditions.description: The number of occupied cells in each 2x2 submatrix does not exceed 3.
